question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"in the."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition** "in"** is followed by the article **"the"** to indicate a specific location or position.

 
 
• **Example**: *The sun sets in the__ west.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the blank is referring to a physical location, so **"in the" **is the most appropriate option.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

At the core of the __epic__ lies the fierce __rivalry__ between two branches of the Kuru dynasty, the Pandavas and the Kauravas. The lifelong struggle __between__ the cousins for the throne of Hastinapur Culminates __in the__ bloody battle of Kurukshetra, in which ______ (5) ______ kings of that period participated and perished.
